page.title: BMI Calculator
page.subtitle: Estimate body mass index instantly in metric or imperial units.

section.title: Enter your measurements
section.description: Switch units at any time. Valid entries update the result automatically, and the review button jumps to the result on smaller screens.

messages.underweight: A lower BMI can reflect reduced body mass. Consider the full context, including health history and clinician guidance when needed.
messages.healthy: This BMI falls inside the standard adult healthy range. BMI is a screening measure, not a full assessment of health.
messages.overweight: This BMI is above the standard adult healthy range. BMI is only one screening input and does not diagnose health conditions.
messages.obesity: This BMI is in the obesity range. Use the result as a screening prompt and follow up with clinical context when appropriate.

disclaimer.title: Adult wellness note
disclaimer.body: BMI is intended here as a quick adult wellness screening measure. It does not diagnose body composition, disease, or overall health.

formula.title: How BMI is calculated
formula.description: The calculator converts the active inputs to metric values, computes BMI, and derives the healthy-weight range from the same height.

points.metric: Metric and imperial entries resolve to the same metric calculation model.
points.range: Healthy-weight range uses BMI 18.5 to 24.9 for the entered height.
points.local: Measurements stay inside the local Utilivo runtime with no network calls.

thresholds.description: Standard adult BMI thresholds used in this tool.
